```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
#| components: [viewer]
#| viewerHeight: 200
from shiny import App, render, ui
import numpy as np

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.tags.script("""
        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
            const mode = parent.document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-mode');
            const body = document.body;
            if (mode === 'dark') {
                body.style.backgroundColor = '#222';
                body.style.color = '#eee';
            } else {
                body.style.backgroundColor = '#fff';
                body.style.color = '#111';
            }
        });
        observer.observe(parent.document.documentElement, { attributes: true });
    """),
    ui.h2("Simple Shiny App"),
    ui.input_slider("n", "Choose a number:", -10, 10, 1),
    ui.output_text_verbatim("txt")
)

def server(input, output, session):
    @output
    @render.text
    def txt():
        return f'Answer: {np.absolute(input.n())}'
   

app = App(app_ui, server)

```
